status: Proposed presentation values; generator geometry and graph remain authoritative

labelRules.overview: Candidate system names + selected star + route endpoints; other stars remain visible dots
labelRules.mid: Add system labels in stable SystemId order, suppress bounding-box collisions; selected/endpoints/candidates have priority
labelRules.close: System labels plus selected region identifier; do not invent body/resource labels
labelRules.invariants: Screen-constant text/targets/strokes; no ownership fill or sensor confidence; no stars added to empty regions

selection.region: Ice boundary + faint neutral ice fill, region-specific inspector including real emptiness
selection.candidate: Separate open bracket hit target and Candidate label, never faction territory or colony
selection.hoverFocus: Ice outline/dashed focus separate from selected state
selection.route: Amber path through actual origin + returned node steps; graph cost from API, never pixel length

layout.structure: Full-width separate review shell, Back to menu, inline seed/size/actions, dominant map, bounded right inspector. No campaign rail or mutation controls.
